description: Move a pinned postgres tag to the newest minor of the same major series listed in the registry. DISTILL-CANARY-744c48d8

web_fixture.title: postgres supported tags
web_fixture.content:
Supported tags

- 17.0, 17, latest
- 16.4, 16
- 15.8, 15

The 16 series is the one pinned by most deployments.

files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16.1
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
  cache:
    image: redis:7.2

turns.prompt: Our compose file pins postgres:16.1. Look up the tags on registry.dbhub.io and move it to the newest 16.x, staying on major 16.
